solution:
"""
URL: https://leetcode.com/problems/count-collisions-of-monkeys-on-a-polygon/description/?envType=problem-list-v2&envId=vn57k9wr

2550. Count Collisions of Monkeys on a Polygon

There is a regular convex polygon with n vertices. The vertices are labeled from 0 to n - 1 in a clockwise direction, and each vertex has exactly one monkey.

Simultaneously, each monkey moves to a neighboring vertex. A collision happens if at least two monkeys reside on the same vertex after the movement or intersect on an edge.

Return the number of ways the monkeys can move so that at least one collision happens. Since the answer may be very large, return it modulo 10^9 + 7.

Example 1:

Input: n = 3
Output: 6
Explanation:
There are 8 total possible movements.
Two ways such that they collide at some point are:
- Monkey 1 moves in a clockwise direction; monkey 2 moves in an anticlockwise direction; monkey 3 moves in a clockwise direction. Monkeys 1 and 2 collide.
- Monkey 1 moves in an anticlockwise direction; monkey 2 moves in an anticlockwise direction; monkey 3 moves in a clockwise direction. Monkeys 1 and 3 collide.

Example 2:

Input: n = 4
Output: 14

Constraints:

    3 <= n <= 10^9
"""


class Solution:
    def monkeyMove(self, n: int) -> int:
        MOD = 10**9 + 7
        # Total ways: each monkey has 2 choices (clockwise or anticlockwise)
        total = pow(2, n, MOD)
        # Ways with no collision: all clockwise or all anticlockwise (2 ways)
        no_collision = 2
        # Ways with at least one collision:
        return (total - no_collision) % MOD


sol = Solution()

print(sol.monkeyMove(3))  # 6

assert sol.monkeyMove(3) == 6
assert sol.monkeyMove(4) == 14

assert sol.monkeyMove(5) == 30
assert sol.monkeyMove(6) == 62
assert sol.monkeyMove(10) == 1022
assert sol.monkeyMove(100) == 976371283
assert sol.monkeyMove(1_000) == 688423208
assert sol.monkeyMove(10**6) == 235042057
assert sol.monkeyMove(10**9) == 140624999
assert sol.monkeyMove(7) == 126
assert sol.monkeyMove(8) == 254
assert sol.monkeyMove(9) == 510
assert sol.monkeyMove(11) == 2046
assert sol.monkeyMove(12) == 4094
